steps.headline: Import from ChatGPT: getting your file, the preview, importing, done.
steps.hint: Open Settings (gear), then Import from ChatGPT under Backup & sync. Press Choose file…, try the switches, then Import 300 conversations. Stop import works while it runs.
steps.notice: Builder's main guide gaps: open guide questions on long-running work, step counters and switches vs tick boxes (it chose itself); nowhere says where a new feature's entry goes.
steps.risk: Picking a file pretends you chose a 312-conversation export.

steps.path: Settings → Import from ChatGPT, some fail
steps.headline: Import from ChatGPT when some conversations couldn't be read.
steps.hint: Settings → Import from ChatGPT → Choose file… → Import 300 conversations. Open Details in the red notice.
steps.notice: Builder: unsure whether the notice's filled Try again counts as the screen's one filled button, so both bottom buttons ended up outlined.

steps.path: Settings → Import from ChatGPT, wrong file
steps.headline: Import from ChatGPT when the file isn't a ChatGPT export.
steps.hint: Settings → Import from ChatGPT → Choose file….
steps.notice: Builder: "every error box has Try again or Report bug" doesn't fit a wrong file, so it offers Choose another file.

steps.path: Settings → Import from ChatGPT, nothing came in
steps.headline: Import from ChatGPT when the import failed completely.
steps.hint: Settings → Import from ChatGPT → Choose file… → Import 300 conversations.
